title: Pressing shift-Ff10 does not open the context menu
line: Shift+F10 now opens the context menu of the selected desktop icons, like the Menu key does.
explanation: Folder View opened an item's context menu only from the Menu key handler; Shift+F10, the standard replacement on keyboards without a Menu key, was not handled anywhere and fell through. The change forwards Shift+F10 in the key handler to the Menu key handler, so it opens the same menu at the current item, or does nothing when nothing is selected.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: open the context menu with Shift+F10

Shift+F10, the usual Menu key replacement on keyboards without one, did
nothing in Folder View, so keyboard users couldn't open an item's menu.
Forward it to the Menu key handler, which opens it at the current item.

BUG: 519354

media.caption: Master: f.txt selected, pointer away, Shift+F10 pressed: no menu
With the fix: same steps, the file's context menu opens at the icon

review.text: Minimal and idiomatic 2-line fix in FolderView.qml that forwards Shift+F10 in Keys.onPressed to Keys.menuPressed(event), matching the existing Keys.onEnterPressed pattern right above it. It properly preserves containment fallback when nothing is selected and avoids the non-reactive dir.hasSelection() binding issue present in the older open MR !4001. Before/after screenshots and keyboard/selection regression checks cleanly verify the behavior.

reviews.text: Minimal and idiomatic 2-line fix in FolderView.qml that forwards Shift+F10 in Keys.onPressed to Keys.menuPressed(event), matching the existing Keys.onEnterPressed pattern right above it. It properly preserves containment fallback when nothing is selected and avoids the non-reactive dir.hasSelection() binding issue present in the older open MR !4001. Before/after screenshots and keyboard/selection regression checks cleanly verify the behavior.

Forwarding Shift+F10 to Keys.menuPressed in the GridView handler is correct and follows the file's own Enter-to-Return pattern, and the shots show the item menu opening. But it only covers Folder View items. When nothing is selected, onMenuPressed passes the event up and ContainmentItem::keyPressEvent opens the desktop menu only for Qt::Key_Menu, so Shift+F10 still does nothing there, where the Menu key opens the desktop menu. The reporter asked for Shift+F10 to behave like the Menu key on the panel and the desktop too. There is also already an open MR from another contributor (!4001) for the same bug, so this should go through that MR rather than a competing one.
changes: Also treat Shift+F10 like Qt::Key_Menu in libplasma ContainmentItem::keyPressEvent (or the equivalent shared place), so the desktop and panel context menus open when no item handles it, and test with nothing selected
Coordinate with plasma-desktop!4001: comment there with the rebase issue and the non-reactive dir.hasSelection() problem, or offer this approach there, instead of opening a parallel MR
